Both insulators are in used vintage condition with minor marks and light wear visible, adding authenticity and character. Their solid weight and striking color make them stand out on a shelf or mantle, ideal for collectors of industrial or railroad memorabilia. It includes a gold-tone ballpoint pen displayed upright in a swivel holder mounted on the onyx base. The set comes in its original brown Cross branded box and includes the guarantee, operating instructions, and a template for centering a nameplate. The pen set appears unused and well-preserved with minimal signs of wear. All original packaging and paperwork are included, suitable for collectors or as a classic executive gift.
